hook_line: MICROSOFT EXPECTS 3,000 OR FEWER TAKERS FOR EXIT OFFER OPEN TO 60,000 STAFF

hook_stat.sub: Or fewer employees Microsoft expects to accept its Voluntary Exit Offer

stats.label: Employees eligible — roughly a quarter of Microsoft's 223,000 workforce
Reported deadline for eligible India staff to decide

diaspora_bullets: The offer covers staff in India, the US, Canada and the UK at level 70 and below
Microsoft says it is on track to equip 20 million people in India with AI skills by 2030
news_summary: Microsoft expects 3,000 or fewer employees to accept its new Voluntary Exit Offer, even though about 60,000 employees in Canada, India, the United Kingdom and the United States are eligible.
payoff: Eligible India staff are reported to have until December 1 to decide on the offer.
